subject.title: fix(chat): keep proof decision out of actor closure

question: Should the explicit `lockProofDecision` / `unlockProofDecision` lifetime in this PR be accepted as the permanent synchronization boundary for queued chat cancellation versus canonical proof?
rationale: The patch appears behavior-preserving and fixes the Swift 6.2 actor-isolation closure capture, but the lock boundary decides a user-visible message-delivery outcome and needs owner intent.

options.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
options.body: Merge after owner review confirms the manual lock/defer shape preserves proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, and cancellation ordering.

options.title: Tighten Lock Scope First
options.body: Ask for a narrower local scope that releases the proof lock immediately after proof decision, SQLite commit, and cache removal while still avoiding the actor-isolated closure capture.

recommendation.title: Accept Explicit Lock Boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after owner review confirms the manual lock/defer shape preserves proof decision, SQLite commit, cache cleanup, and cancellation ordering.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is both the live assignee and the current blame route for the helper and cancellation path.
